root_cause_summary: OUR-BUG (release engineering), not user network/environment. User clicked the in-app 'Official Website' link (https://www.aionui.com, via shell.openExternal, itself succeeded 200) then tried to download AionUi from the website's download button. Confirmed by external verification (GitHub Releases API + GitHub Actions run + direct CDN HTTP probes + website JS bundle deobfuscation), not app-side attachments: GitHub Release tag_name is 'v2.1.47-final' (published 2026-08-05T07:52:23Z) but package.json/electron-builder-generated latest.yml carries version '2.1.47' (no '-final' suffix) -- the '-final' suffix was added to the git tag only (marking AionUi's last open-source-distributed build per PR #3730), not propagated to package.json. release-distribute.yml's 'Validate updater metadata' step does `VERSION="${TAG#v}"` (= '2.1.47-final') and compares it against latest.yml's `version:` field (= '2.1.47'); mismatch -> `exit 1` -> 'Upload assets' and 'Upload updater metadata' steps skipped -> the entire 2.1.47 release was NEVER copied to the static.aionui.com/S3 CDN. The website's download button independently constructs its URL as `${CDN_BASE}/${tag_name_without_v}/AionUi-${tag_name_without_v}-${os}-${arch}.${ext}` directly from the GitHub Release tag_name (deobfuscated from the production JS bundle: `Jl(t,a,n,s){...return `${pA}/${t}/AionUi-${t}-${u}.${s}`}` with `pA='https://static.aionui.com/releases'`), so it always requests .../releases/2.1.47-final/AionUi-2.1.47-final-win-x64.exe -- an object that was never uploaded -> HTTP 403 from CloudFront/S3. In-app auto-update independently corroborates: aioncore log line 'Update for version 2.1.47 is not available (latest version: 2.1.46, downgrade is disallowed)' proves the CDN authoritative version is still the prior release.
diagnostic_gap: This Sentry feedback event carries no free-text user comment (module=system-settings feedback classification prefix was the entire text) and no screenshot attachment; db-diagnostics.json.gz's 4 profiles are all empty/healthy (correctly -- the failure is server-side/CDN, not local app state). The case was located entirely via breadcrumbs (open-external click sequence + timing) plus external, out-of-band verification against GitHub/CDN -- none of AionUi's own diagnostics packages (logs/db) can see the CDN or the release-distribute CI outcome. There is no automated alert (Slack/email) when release-distribute.yml fails; the team only found out via this user feedback ~2.6 hours after the failed run.
